title: A superseded approval can pass a head-bound gate again once it is reopened at the head the approval names
resolution: Head-bound evidence names the generation of the pending gate it was recorded for, and a head-bound gate rejects evidence for any other generation; regression tests cover both reopening paths

title: The living Gate transitions scenario Reopening a gate contradicts reopenGate refusing a head-bound gate, because the delta only adds requirements
resolution: A MODIFIED Gate transitions requirement scopes the Reopening a gate scenario to reopenGate for gates without a code head and reopenGateAtCodeHead for head-bound gates

title: Evidence names no gate, so an approval for one gate at a head and generation passes another gate with the same kind, subject, head, and generation
resolution: Evidence carries gateId, and recordGateEvidence accepts it only for the gate's id and generation; regression tests cover a parallel gate and a later gate at the same head

title: Gates without a code head were exempted from the generation binding without a coordinator decision, so an edit and revert still restore an approval there
resolution: By the coordinator's decision every gate binds evidence to its id and generation; a regression test covers an edit, its revert, and reopenGate on a gate without a code head

title: parseEvidenceFacts passes the gate generation and the code head repository through without validating them
resolution: parseEvidenceFacts validates the repository, the gate id, and the generation and fails with invalid naming the field

title: The GateReopened description and summary say a head-bound gate reopens only for a new code head, though it can reopen at the same head
resolution: The GateReopened description and summary name a head-bound gate reopened for a subject at a code head

title: The Edit reverted scenario does not name the reopened generation that the requirement demands
resolution: The THEN of Edit reverted names the reopened generation

title: The Git workspace contract calls the naming follow-up a recommendation without naming it and leaves the item 17 pending entry unchanged
resolution: The contract names the coordinator's chosen follow-up align-code-head-names and marks the item 17 entry met for the SDLC gates and evidence

title: The author self-check gives the requirement character counts from before the pass 1 fix
resolution: The author self-check gives the character counts as of the pass 2 fixes

title: A markGateStale call in the artifact edit test is refused only by the state machine and tests no artifact edit
resolution: The test makes the passed gate stale with an edited specification, checks the reopenGate refusal, and reopens at the same head

title: No test shows that reopenGate and reopenGateAtCodeHead check the transition before the head binding, as the delta states
resolution: A test expects the passed-to-pending transition error from both reopen operations on head-bound and unbound passed gates
